definitions.explanation: The lane on the left side of the road. In Japan, where vehicles drive on the left, the left lane is typically the slower, regular-traffic lane.

examples.japanese: {左車線|ひだりしゃせん}を{走|はし}ってください。
examples.english: Please drive in the left lane.

examples.japanese: {高速道路|こうそくどうろ}では、{左車線|ひだりしゃせん}が{走行|そうこう}{車線|しゃせん}になっている。
examples.english: On the expressway, the left lane is the driving lane.

examples.japanese: {次|つぎ}の{出口|でぐち}で{降|お}りるので、そろそろ{左車線|ひだりしゃせん}に{移|うつ}ったほうがいい。
examples.english: We're getting off at the next exit, so we should move to the left lane soon.

notes:
Composed of {左|ひだり} (left) and {車線|しゃせん} (traffic lane). In Japan's left-hand traffic system, the {左車線|ひだりしゃせん} is the regular driving lane, while the {右車線|みぎしゃせん} is used for overtaking. This is the opposite of right-hand traffic countries.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {左車線|ひだりしゃせん}に{入|はい}る: to merge into the left lane
- {左車線|ひだりしゃせん}を{走行|そうこう}する: to drive in the left lane
- {左車線|ひだりしゃせん}に{寄|よ}る: to move toward the left lane

RELATED WORDS:
- {右車線|みぎしゃせん}: right lane — the overtaking lane in Japan
- {走行車線|そうこうしゃせん}: driving lane — the regular-speed lane
- {追越車線|おいこししゃせん}: passing lane — the faster lane
